OPENAI_PARAMS.instructions: Voice: a young Indonesian woman, native Jakarta accent. Read numbers the Indonesian way (Rp 63,3 miliar = "enam puluh tiga koma tiga miliar rupiah"). Age: mid-twenties. Tone: fresh, sparkling and radiant, warm with high energy, expressive intonation that rises with good news and settles calmly on the caveat at the end. Pace: lively but clear.
